limitations: AOI is the Batch 01 pilot bbox, not an official Gia Loc ward boundary.
Microsoft footprints are ML-derived from Bing Maps imagery; not cadastral/survey-grade.
Microsoft source uses -1 placeholders where height or confidence is unavailable; derived height_m/confidence are null in those cases.
Area is approximate from clipped EPSG:4326 coordinates projected with a local equirectangular scale for QA/browser use.

Derived Microsoft bounds start at lon 106.34764410699349, leaving about 0.02001030699349 degrees (~2186 m at AOI latitude) of the western AOI span without Microsoft footprints in this extracted layer; do not infer absence of real buildings.

coverageSparsity.interpretation: No Microsoft footprints were returned in the western span of the pilot AOI by this tile/filter. This is source detection/coverage sparsity only; it is not evidence that real buildings are absent.
